question: Can the previously qualified CMU/107 original/tuck pair support a robust arm-clearance intervention outside existing KIT groups?
hypothesis: A portal admits tucked execution but induces arm contact in the original, while both pass relaxed, removed and displaced controls.
rival: Empty-plane teacher support does not imply enough robust arm-clearance contrast, or geometry does not survive obstacle execution.
preflight_reuse: Both continuations already pass all three paired offsets; verify hashes, common entry, teacher and source before use.

geometry.repetitions: All three measured preflight perturbations; full 200-frame trajectories
geometry.selection: Largest min(clearance-0.03, -inner_witness-0.01) over all perturbations among candidates passing control geometry; ties by frame then gap.
geometry.controls: Same portal relaxed by +0.60 m gap, removed, or displaced +2.0 m laterally; both continuations must retain >=0.03 m sampled bounds in nonempty controls.
geometry.negative_witness: Inscribed balls in analytic shoulder/elbow/wrist primitives only; no mesh bounding-box penetration as a positive contact label.
geometry.failure_rule: Retain all candidates; no additional search, threshold relaxation, edits or replacement after this grid.

execution: One selected geometry, four conditions, two unchanged continuations, three original preflight initial offsets. Existing teacher/assets/scorer fixed.
qualification: Complete matched 8-episode panel: six controls and positive critical pass; negative critical has mechanism-specific arm contact; common-entry error <=1e-5; all task thresholds unchanged.
outputs: New proposal/run directories, all candidate outcomes, public aggregate, Chinese report, next decision. Licensed trajectories remain local.
decision: If no robust geometry: diagnose the carrier/contrast bottleneck without launching. If physics fails: retain complete failures and locate geometry versus control failure. If all panels pass: add one pair/source group to acquisition coverage; then register a fixed-budget proposer comparison before learner training.
